questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
The level of courses compared to Denmark, I would describe as higher meaning that this individual causes demand way, more of every student individual, there, barely any group works. So you're going to write your papers on yourself, and you will do it alone and you will do everything, so that's not really a chance of sneaking out of things which are not your favorite. Additional, the level, which is expected in most of the xms which are usually written ones, is pretty high and also to achieve high
grades.You
usually have to deliver a lot in a short time. Further, the grading system in Italy is a liniar grading system from 0 to 30 points. Where in most exsames, great points actually represent corection points. This\n Means that, for example, a mark of 27 means represents 90% correct. However, when transfer to the Danish grading system, these marks only translates to a 7. So with 90% correct, you only get a 7.  You have to deliver really highly if you want that being represented in your grades in denmark.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
My feeling is that it is way less didactical, more straightforward, and in terms of content on higher level. Projects and papers are written alone rather than group works, and the demand for scientificly correct work is higher then in denmark. In general, I had the feeling that lectures in Italy rather try to prepare you for a scientific career and a ph.D while in denmark , lectures rather try to educate you for a some sort of corporate job. 


. So a bit less, do it yourself mentality, and therefore, lectures tend to be closer to science than to a textbook.
